resources.string: Could not extract the game data: %1$s

OpenTTD keeps its configuration, savegames, scenarios, heightmaps and downloaded content in this folder. Choose a folder outside of Android/data to manage these files with any file manager, or to keep them when the app is uninstalled.
To use a folder outside of its own app folder, OpenTTD needs the \"All files access\" permission, as the game reads and writes its files directly.
OpenTTD has no access to %1$s, so the default folder is used. Grant access to use your folder again.
Please choose a folder on the device storage or an SD card.

Copy your existing files from %1$s to %2$s?
Files that already exist in the new folder are kept. The old folder is not changed.

Copying the files failed: %1$s
The storage location has not been changed.
OpenTTD needs to restart to use the new folder. Your current game was saved as \"background.sav\" in the autosave folder.
